Description: Verify that the Organizations list shows a Frequency column placed after User quota, with the value "Daily" or "One time" on each row. Covers AC-1.
Test name: TC-GEO-1172-001 - Frequency column is displayed after User quota with Daily or One time
Test step: Given the super admin is logged in to the back office
Expected result: The back office home page is displayed
QA Precondition: The user is logged in to the GEO back office with a super admin account (back office URL on staging: https://staging-geo.onclusive.com/geo/backoffice). Administration > Organizations is reachable. At least one organization with collection frequency DAILY (org D = QA-GEO) and one with ONE_TIME (org O = Onclusive) exist.

Test name: TC-GEO-1172-001 - Frequency column is displayed after User quota with Daily or One time
Test step: When the super admin opens Administration > Organizations
Expected result: The Organizations list loads without error

Test name: TC-GEO-1172-001 - Frequency column is displayed after User quota with Daily or One time
Test step: Then the list header shows a Frequency column placed right after the User quota column
Expected result: Header order: Name, Customer number, User quota, Frequency, US org, Status, Created at, Actions

Test name: TC-GEO-1172-001 - Frequency column is displayed after User quota with Daily or One time
Test step: And every row with a quota shows "Daily" or "One time" in the Frequency column
Expected result: No other value (e.g. DAILY, ONE_TIME, blank) is shown for organizations that have a quota

Test name: TC-GEO-1172-001 - Frequency column is displayed after User quota with Daily or One time
Test step: And the row of the DAILY organization shows "Daily"
Expected result: The Frequency cell of org D reads "Daily"

Test name: TC-GEO-1172-001 - Frequency column is displayed after User quota with Daily or One time
Test step: And the row of the ONE_TIME organization shows "One time"
Expected result: The Frequency cell of org O reads "One time"

Description: Verify that an organization with no quota row shows the same empty marker as the other optional columns in the Frequency cell, and that the list still loads. Covers AC-2.
Test name: TC-GEO-1172-002 - Organization without a quota row shows the empty marker and the list does not fail
Test step: Given an organization without a quota row exists
Expected result: Org N is present without an active quota row
QA Precondition: The user is logged in to the GEO back office with a super admin account (back office URL on staging: https://staging-geo.onclusive.com/geo/backoffice). Administration > Organizations is reachable. An organization with no quota row exists (legacy or edge case, org N). QA to provide its name, or to have one created by a developer (no UI path is known to create it). The empty marker used by the other optional columns (e.g. an empty Customer number) must be noted before execution.

Test name: TC-GEO-1172-002 - Organization without a quota row shows the empty marker and the list does not fail
Test step: When the super admin opens Administration > Organizations
Expected result: The Organizations list loads with no error message and no blank page

Test name: TC-GEO-1172-002 - Organization without a quota row shows the empty marker and the list does not fail
Test step: And the super admin locates the row of the organization without a quota row
Expected result: The row of org N is displayed with its other columns filled

Test name: TC-GEO-1172-002 - Organization without a quota row shows the empty marker and the list does not fail
Test step: Then the Frequency cell of that row shows the same empty marker as the other optional columns
Expected result: The Frequency cell shows the same marker as an empty optional cell (e.g. empty Customer number), not "Daily", "One time", "null" or an error

Test name: TC-GEO-1172-002 - Organization without a quota row shows the empty marker and the list does not fail
Test step: And the other rows of the list are still displayed with their Frequency value
Expected result: Rows of other organizations show "Daily" or "One time" as usual

Description: Verify that clicking the Frequency column header cycles the rows through ascending, descending and no sort, exactly like the other sortable columns. Covers AC-3.

Test step: Given the super admin is on the Organizations list with no sort applied
Expected result: The rows are in the default order and no sort indicator is shown on the Frequency header
QA Precondition: The user is logged in to the GEO back office with a super admin account (back office URL on staging: https://staging-geo.onclusive.com/geo/backoffice). Administration > Organizations is reachable. The current page of the list contains organizations with both "Daily" and "One time" values. Before execution, QA notes the click cycle and sort indicator of another sortable column (e.g. Name) as the reference behaviour.

Test name: TC-GEO-1172-003 - Frequency column header sorts ascending then descending then back to no sort
Test step: When the super admin clicks the Frequency column header once
Expected result: The Frequency header shows the ascending sort indicator

Test name: TC-GEO-1172-003 - Frequency column header sorts ascending then descending then back to no sort
Test step: Then the rows are sorted by frequency in ascending order
Expected result: All "Daily" rows are listed before all "One time" rows

Test name: TC-GEO-1172-003 - Frequency column header sorts ascending then descending then back to no sort
Test step: When the super admin clicks the Frequency column header a second time
Expected result: The Frequency header shows the descending sort indicator

Test name: TC-GEO-1172-003 - Frequency column header sorts ascending then descending then back to no sort
Test step: Then the rows are sorted by frequency in descending order
Expected result: All "One time" rows are listed before all "Daily" rows

Test name: TC-GEO-1172-003 - Frequency column header sorts ascending then descending then back to no sort
Test step: When the super admin clicks the Frequency column header a third time
Expected result: The sort indicator is removed from the Frequency header

Test name: TC-GEO-1172-003 - Frequency column header sorts ascending then descending then back to no sort
Test step: Then the rows are back in the default order
Expected result: The row order is the same as before the first click

Test name: TC-GEO-1172-003 - Frequency column header sorts ascending then descending then back to no sort
Test step: And the click cycle and indicators match the other sortable columns
Expected result: Same three-state cycle and same indicator icons as the reference column

Description: Verify that after saving a new frequency in the organization modal, the Frequency column of that row shows the new value without a manual page reload. Covers AC-5.

Expected result: The row of org T shows "Daily" in the Frequency column

Administration > Organizations is reachable. A test organization with frequency DAILY exists (org T = QA-GEO) and may be modified. Its frequency is restored to DAILY at the end of the test.

Test name: TC-GEO-1172-006 - Frequency changed in the organization modal is shown in the list without reload
Test step: When the super admin opens the organization modal of org T

Test name: TC-GEO-1172-006 - Frequency changed in the organization modal is shown in the list without reload

Test name: TC-GEO-1172-006 - Frequency changed in the organization modal is shown in the list without reload
Test step: Then the Frequency column of org T shows "One time" without a manual page reload
Expected result: The row of org T reads "One time"; the page was not reloaded by the tester

Test name: TC-GEO-1172-006 - Frequency changed in the organization modal is shown in the list without reload
Test step: When the super admin reopens the modal of org T, sets the frequency back to Daily and saves
Expected result: The save is confirmed and the modal closes

Test name: TC-GEO-1172-006 - Frequency changed in the organization modal is shown in the list without reload
Test step: Then the Frequency column of org T shows "Daily" without a manual page reload
Expected result: The row of org T reads "Daily", the same value as in the modal
